title: English Practice Quiz 0945
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A stock count is carried out to compare physical items with ___.
questions.explanation: A stock count checks whether records match actual quantities.

questions.question: The term 'reorder level' refers to the stock quantity at which an organisation should ___.
questions.explanation: The reorder level helps prevent stock from running out.

questions.question: A damaged item found during inspection should be ___.
options: recorded and handled according to procedure
mixed with saleable stock without checking
questions.explanation: Recording damage supports accountability and correct stock handling.

questions.question: FIFO in stock management means ___.
questions.explanation: FIFO means older stock is issued before newer stock.

questions.question: A delivery note is used to record ___.
questions.explanation: A delivery note lists goods supplied in a delivery.

questions.question: A stock discrepancy is a difference between recorded and ___.
questions.explanation: A discrepancy indicates that the physical count does not match the records.

questions.question: A purchase order is generally sent to a ___.
questions.explanation: A purchase order formally requests goods or services from a supplier.

questions.question: A minimum stock level helps an organisation avoid ___.
questions.explanation: Minimum levels provide a warning before stock becomes too low.

questions.question: When receiving a delivery, staff should check the goods against the ___.
questions.explanation: Comparing documents helps confirm that the correct items were supplied.

questions.question: A stock ledger records ___.
options: receipts, issues and balances of items
questions.explanation: A stock ledger tracks movements and balances.
